flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/?fixed then Open the first product.
Store its name as {{product_name}}.
Click "Add to cart" without ticking or choosing any extra options.
Then open the cart.
Store the names of every line item in the cart, separated by " | ", as {{cart_items}}, and store how many different line items are in the cart as {{cart_line_count}}.
Never enter payment details and never place a real order.

remark: click: Clicking the first product’s View deal link
analyze: The product's name is stored as {{product_name}}.
wait: PRIMARY: wait for the cart page to finish loading
analyze: ANALYZE(textual_visual, 'How many different line items are in the cart is stored
wait: Waiting after confirming the cart contains the added product

summary:
You asked to open the first product, add it to the cart without selecting extra options, and open the cart.
Opened the first product, AirWave Pro Earbuds, and added it to the cart without choosing any additional options.
Opened the cart; it contains one line item: AirWave Pro Earbuds.
No payment details were entered and no order was placed.
one_liner: added the first product to the cart on the local shopping site

product_name.condition: The product's name is stored as {{product_name}}.
product_name.human_description: Extracting the product name from the product heading

cart_items.query: the names of all cart line items in the cart list, separated by a vertical bar
cart_items.condition: The names of every line item in the cart, separated by " | ", are stored as {{cart_items}}.
cart_items.human_description: Extracting the names of cart line items

cart_line_count.query: the number of distinct cart line-item rows in the cart list
cart_line_count.condition: How many different line items are in the cart is stored as {{cart_line_count}}.
